fact_check.claim: Membership requires a valid and current registration status with the university, except for a day pass
fact_check.note: FAQ says membership requires 'a valid and current registration status with Cornell University' except for a Day Pass. Page does not mention alumni.

fact_check.claim: Student prices 2026-27: $60 half fall semester (Oct 15, 2026 to Jan 15, 2027) up to $180 academic year
fact_check.note: Half Fall $60, Oct 15 2026 to Jan 15 2027; Academic Year $180, Aug 1 2026 to May 28 2027. Page does not mention alumni or community members.

fact_check.claim: $10 day pass for students and their guests
fact_check.note: CFC Day Pass $10, valid on the day of purchase, available to Cornell students and their guests.

fact_check.claim: A day pass must be bought for a guest by a valid and registered Cornell affiliate; patrons must be 18 or older
fact_check.note: FAQ: a registered Cornell affiliate must buy the Day Pass on the guest's behalf; patrons must be 18 or older.

fact_check.claim: A current student or employee can buy you a day pass (also flowchart step: 'Ask a current student or employee about a day pass')
fact_check.note: Wellness FAQ says day passes and guest passes are not available to employees, retirees or their spouses/partners. Only students are shown buying day or guest passes, so 'or employee' contradicts the source.

fact_check.claim: Wellness FAQ: retirees, spouses and partners cannot buy day or guest passes; guest passes for non-Cornell individuals are not sold to employees, retirees or spouses/partners
fact_check.note: Both stated. Source says non-Cornell guest passes are unavailable 'at this time' because facilities are heavily used; the article drops that qualifier.

fact_check.claim: Wellness FAQ says memberships depend on the primary status on your Cornell ID; it does not address alumni
fact_check.note: Eligibility depends on primary status assigned by the Registrar, shown on the ID. No alumni mention. The page also says retirees and spouses/partners can try the centers with a Cornell ID and waiver during designated free trial periods, which the article omits.

fact_check.claim: Check-in requires a Cornell ID or another photo ID; staff can deny entry if membership cannot be verified
fact_check.note: FAQ: check in at front desk; Cornell ID or other photo ID is the most reliable way; unverifiable membership and ID means denied access.

fact_check.claim: FAQ mentions free access periods only in passing, with no dates or eligibility
fact_check.note: Page says memberships are required unless the center hosts a free access period; no details.

fact_check.claim: Main office phone 607-254-2824 and fitness@cornell.edu
fact_check.note: Both listed on the FAQ.

fact_check.claim: Main office hours Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm
fact_check.note: The FAQ lists no office hours (it points to a separate hours page) and the article gives no source link for this fact. Remove it or source it from an official hours page.

fact_check.claim: Benefits-eligible endowed employees on the CPHL plan get a free Wellness Recreation Membership
fact_check.note: Page says eligible CPHL enrollees may sign up free of charge at any time.

fact_check.claim: Standard recreation membership is $180 per year or $15 per month
fact_check.note: 'The annual Cornell Recreation Membership fee is $180, which breaks down to $15 per month.' No alumni mention.

fact_check.claim: Membership perks: Helen Newman, Teagle Upstairs, Teagle Downstairs, Noyes, Toni Morrison fitness centers plus lap swimming at Helen Newman and Teagle pools
fact_check.note: All five centers and both pools listed.

fact_check.claim: If you return as a grad student you buy the student membership
fact_check.note: Consistent with the student membership page (students buy online via NetID); grad students are not named explicitly.

fact_check.claim: Cornell Club-New York includes its Health & Fitness Center with club membership, open seven days a week
fact_check.note: Listed as complimentary with club membership; 'open seven days a week'.

fact_check.claim: The club serves Cornellians, Business Associates and alumni of affiliate schools; dues and initiation fee not published; phone 212.986.0300
fact_check.note: All confirmed; membership dept follows up on dues and initiation fee after application.

fact_check.claim: YMCA hours: Mon-Fri 5:30 am-9:00 pm, Sat 8:00 am-5:00 pm, Sun 9:00 am-4:00 pm; phone (607) 257-0101; lower-cost memberships for those who qualify
fact_check.note: All confirmed. Page lists no prices; it links a Rates and Discounts page (membership/rates-and-discounts/) that the article did not use.

fact_check.claim: Island Health & Fitness: group fitness, lap pool, hydro-therapy pool, whirlpool; downtown at 310 Taughannock Blvd.; phone (607) 277-3861
fact_check.note: All confirmed. Community Corners is listed at 409 East Upland Rd. Suite 105 (607-319-0149) and also at 903 Hanshaw Road, matching the article's warning. Site links Memberships & Pricing (/become-a-member/) and Pricing & Tours (/tour/), unused by the article.

fact_check.claim: Planet Fitness also operates in Ithaca (no details given)
fact_check.note: No source link and the article admits the site was blocked; the claim is unsourced. Drop it or link a source.

beats_top.why: The #1 result is Cornell's own fitness centers page, which gives student and employee options and says nothing about alumni; our first paragraph answers the alumni question directly (probably not, current registration required) and gives a next step. It is weakened by the Ithaca gym table having no prices and by no direct confirmation from Cornell Recreation.
changes: Add actual membership prices for the YMCA and Island Health & Fitness from their official rates pages, so the 'alumni who stay' section gives numbers.
Fix the day pass advice so it names only a current student, matching the sources, and mention the retiree free trial periods only as not applicable to alumni.
Remove the unsourced office hours and the Planet Fitness line.

fixes: In the day pass section (paragraph beginning 'That leaves a friend...' and the sentence 'a current student or employee has to buy it for you'), change 'a current student or employee' to 'a current student'. The wellness FAQ (https://scl.cornell.edu/recreation/recreation/employee-wellness-program/wellness-membership-policies-faqs) says day and guest passes are not available to employees, retirees or their spouses/partners.
In the steps figure, change the row 'Ask a current student or employee about a day pass' to 'Ask a current student about a day pass'.
In the FAQ answer 'Who do I contact?', delete '(Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm)'. The cited FAQ lists no office hours. Optionally link the official Fitness Center Hours page instead.
Delete the sentence 'Planet Fitness also operates in Ithaca, but its site blocked us, so we have no verified details to give.' It has no source link.

In the Ithaca gyms table, replace 'We could not load a published price' with real prices: open https://www.ithacaymca.com/membership/rates-and-discounts/ and https://www.islandhealthfitness.com/become-a-member/ (or /tour/), add each published monthly or annual rate with the link and date accessed, and add a Price column. If a page still shows no price, say so for that gym only.

In the 'Retirees' bullet, add that the wellness FAQ says retirees and spouses/partners can try the centers with a Cornell ID and waiver during designated free trial periods, and say this applies to retirees only and not to alumni, so readers do not mistake it for an alumni option. Link the wellness FAQ.
